title: Energy crisis reinforces comeback of nuclear power, says IEA
summary: The IEA's new outlook lifts its nuclear forecast: stated-policies capacity reaches 886 GW by 2050, versus 728 GW a year ago, with nearly 90 GW under construction.

title: enCore Energy Receives Final Wellfield Authorization at Upper Spring Creek; Uranium Extraction Expected to Begin in Early December
summary: Texas regulators authorised the first wellfield at enCore's Upper Spring Creek ISR project; extraction should start in early December, pending a disposal-well approval.

title: Russia says US, despite current sanctions, will likely need more of its uranium in future
summary: Russia's nuclear chief said the United States will probably need more Russian uranium in future despite the sanctions now on the books.

title: Bangladesh's Rooppur 1 supplies country's first nuclear energy
summary: Rooppur 1 made its trial grid connection, giving Bangladesh its first nuclear electricity and adding a new uranium-consuming country to the market.

title: Kazakhstan to mothball uranium deposits for future nuclear plants
summary: Kazakhstan will hold back some deposits and build a strategic reserve of at least 150,000 tonnes of uranium by end-2027, about seven years of national output.

title: Uranium price hits record as AI demand prompts nuclear comeback
summary: Nikkei reports uranium prices at record highs as data-centre power demand, Japan's push for stable fuel and Middle East disruption tighten supply.

title: Germany eyes RWE, E.ON's stakes in nuclear firm Urenco, newspapers say
summary: German newspapers say Berlin is weighing a purchase of the one-third of enricher Urenco owned by RWE and E.ON, reportedly worth about EUR4 billion.

title: Centrus, Oklo deal secures fuel for Ohio reactor deployment
summary: Oklo signed definitive HALEU purchase agreements with Centrus, backed by USD35 million of prepayments, for deliveries from Piketon starting in 2029.

title: A$525M Fully Underwritten Equity Raising
summary: Paladin launched an A$525 million raising at A$7.80 a share, a 10.3% discount, to fund Patterson Lake South development and repay debt.

title: Nuclear Revival Spurs CME to Move Ahead on Physical Uranium Contracts
summary: CME Group is moving ahead with physically delivered uranium futures; follow-up reports say it is close to a storage arrangement for the contract.

title: House Passes American Enrichment Deployment Act in 394–3 Vote on U.S. Nuclear Fuel
summary: The US House voted 394-3 for a bill intended to speed licensing of domestic uranium enrichment plants; the measure now goes to the Senate.

title: OPG set to revise timeline and cost of first SMR unit
summary: Ontario Power Generation said Darlington's first BWRX-300 will miss its October 2030 target and CAD7.7 billion budget because first-of-a-kind engineering is unfinished.

title: US issues landmark construction permit for Texas SMR plant
summary: The NRC issued a construction permit for four Xe-100 reactors at Dow's Seadrift site, its first for a high-temperature gas reactor in nearly 60 years.

title: Uzbekistan plans to double uranium production
summary: State miner Navoiyuran aims to raise output from 7,500 tU this year to 15,000 tU by 2030 and lift explored reserves to 200,000 tU.

title: Denison Reports Financial and Operational Results for Q3 2026, Highlighted by 24% Total Completion after First Quarter of Full-Scale Construction at Phoenix ISR Uranium Mine
summary: Phoenix ISR mine construction is about 24% complete with CAD161 million spent this year; first production remains targeted for the second half of 2028.

title: Kazatomprom 3Q26 Operations and Trading Update
summary: Third-quarter output rose 12% to 7,216 tU (100% basis) and 2026 guidance of 27,500-29,000 tU was reiterated; the realised price averaged USD81.50/lb.

title: Urenco USA marks first commercial LEU+ production
summary: Urenco USA filled its first cylinder of LEU+ at Eunice, New Mexico, which it calls the first commercial production of the material in the West.

title: Cameco Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results
summary: Cameco narrowed 2026 production guidance to 19.5-20.5 Mlb (its share) after a longer planned Key Lake mill outage cut third-quarter output to 3.5 Mlb.

title: Uranium shares slide even as analysts see tighter supply
summary: Uranium equities sold off in late October even though analysts still expect the physical market to tighten, widening the gap between miners and the metal.

title: Centrus ships first centrifuge for Piketon plant expansion
summary: Centrus sent the first newly built centrifuge from Oak Ridge to Piketon, Ohio, starting the installation phase of its multibillion-dollar enrichment expansion.

title: Kazatomprom to rethink Russian uranium deal after initial shareholder rejection
summary: After the October abstentions, Kazatomprom will hold a second absentee vote, from 27 November to 9 December, on a uranium supply contract with Rosatom's Uranium One.

title: Energy Department Announces $5 Billion Loan to Boost Nuclear Power and Help Lower Costs in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania
summary: DOE offered Constellation a conditional loan of up to USD5 billion for uprates adding nearly 1.1 GW across its Illinois, Maryland and Pennsylvania reactors.

title: QUARTERLY OPERATING UPDATE
summary: Yellow Cake put spot at USD89.50/lb and the long-term price at USD96/lb on 30 September, and held 24.37 Mlb after its Kazatomprom purchase.

title: Korea's Kori 3 and 4 set for restarts in 2027
summary: South Korea's regulator approved ten more years of operation for the two idled 1,025 MWe Kori units, which KHNP plans to restart in 2027.

title: Regulatory milestone for US laser enrichment plant
summary: The NRC's final environmental impact statement recommends licensing Global Laser Enrichment's Paducah plant; the final safety evaluation is expected by year-end.

title: FID sees Etango enter full-scale construction
summary: The Bannerman-CNNC joint venture approved the USD353 million Etango mine, sized at 3.5 Mlb U3O8 a year with first production targeted for 2028.

title: Implementing the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026
summary: Executive Order 14436, signed 16 October, waived most of the new Russia sanctions law, including its Russian uranium import provisions, according to Kazatomprom's market review.

title: Westinghouse invests USD1 billion in US LEU+ fuel plant
summary: Westinghouse will spend USD1 billion on a new LEU+ fuel factory at its Columbia site in South Carolina, aiming to start operations in 2030.

title: Aura aims for final investment decision on Mauritania project this year
summary: Aura targets a year-end investment decision on Tiris after a bankable study, while Deep Yellow says equity markets do not support approving Tumas this quarter.

title: AEP, Amazon and X-energy planning 12-SMR plant
summary: AEP and X-energy will evaluate a 960 MW plant of twelve Xe-100 reactors at a former Indiana coal site, with Amazon funding development and buying the output.

title: Mochovce 4 connected to the grid
summary: Slovakia's 471 MWe Mochovce 4 delivered its first power on 15 October, adding another operating reactor to global fuel demand.

title: Quarterly Report – September 2026
summary: Langer Heinrich produced 1.00 Mlb in the September quarter, down from 1.23 Mlb, after a planned shutdown; FY2027 guidance was kept and sales averaged USD79.4/lb.

title: Voting results of the EGM of Shareholders
summary: Shareholders approved a spot-term uranium contract with China's SNURDC (88.6% in favour), but a supply contract with Rosatom's Uranium One failed as 88.3% abstained.

title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
summary: CNNC connected Tianwan 7, a Russian-designed VVER-1200, to the grid on 8 October, just over a week after first criticality.

title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
summary: Google signed a 3.6 GW supply deal with Constellation; the utility's filings say the 20-year contract supports USD4.3 billion of uprates adding about 890 MW.

title: USA, South Korea targeting six AP1000 and two APR1400 units
summary: A non-binding USD120 billion framework envisages Korean financing for six AP1000 and two APR1400 reactors in the United States, plus a possible Westinghouse stake.

title: First construction permit issued for BWRX-300 SMR in the US
summary: The NRC issued TVA a construction permit for a BWRX-300 at Clinch River, finishing its review in 14 months, four months ahead of schedule.

title: General Matter submits licence application for enrichment plant
summary: Privately held General Matter filed an NRC licence application of more than 1,000 pages for a commercial enrichment plant at Paducah, Kentucky.

title: Uranium Energy Corp Reports Fiscal 2026 Results
source: Uranium Energy Corp (press release, SEC exhibit)
summary: UEC produced 229,294 lb U3O8 in fiscal 2026, sold 400,000 lb at USD93.13/lb and ended with 1.26 Mlb of inventory and no debt.

title: Agreement clears way for resumption of Niger uranium project
summary: Atomic Eagle's 60%-owned subsidiary signed a Mining Convention with Niger for Madaouela, restoring rights withdrawn from GoviEx in 2024 and ending arbitration.

title: Italy's Senate approves a return to nuclear power
summary: Italy's Senate voted 81-51 for the enabling law that reopens the door to nuclear power four decades after the country abandoned it.

title: Bechtel steps away from TerraPower project
summary: TerraPower will rebid the construction contract for its 345 MWe Natrium demonstration reactor in Kemmerer, Wyoming, after parting ways with Bechtel.

title: US seeks faster uranium enrichment expansion to avert supply shortages
summary: Reuters reported that US officials want domestic enrichment capacity built faster to head off a looming shortage of enriched uranium.

title: US backs Global Atomic’s Niger uranium mine with $414M loan
summary: The US Development Finance Corporation approved up to USD414 million of debt for Global Atomic's high-grade Dasa project, three years after Niger's coup strained ties with Washington.

title: Cameco in offtake agreement for US laser enrichment plant
summary: Cameco will buy and market the entire future output of Global Laser Enrichment's planned Paducah plant, in which it already owns 49%.

title: Red Book confident on uranium resources to meet future growth
summary: The NEA/IAEA Red Book finds resources adequate even if demand doubles by 2050, but only with sustained investment; exploration spending rose 46% to USD1.8 billion.

title: Chubu withdraws restart applications for Hamaoka units
summary: Chubu Electric is withdrawing restart applications for Hamaoka 3 and 4 after a committee found staff felt pressured to manipulate earthquake data.

title: New study sets 'robust' pathway for Honeymoon project
summary: Boss Energy's reset feasibility study plans 13.8 Mlb U3O8 from Honeymoon over nine years, replacing the withdrawn 2021 study.

title: US Department of Energy closes loan for Duane Arnold restart
summary: DOE closed a loan of up to USD1.9 billion to NextEra to help restart Iowa's Duane Arnold reactor, shut since 2020.

title: Fuel loading under way for Palisades restart, Holtec announces
summary: Holtec began loading 204 fuel assemblies at Palisades in Michigan, moving toward the first restart of a US reactor that had closed for decommissioning.

title: EIA details 2025 gains in U.S. uranium production
summary: EIA data show US producers made about 2.1 Mlb U3O8 in 2025, more than triple 2024's 657,000 lb and the most since 2017.

title: Niger awards Arlit uranium mining permit to state-owned company
summary: Niger awarded the Arlit permit formerly held by Orano's SOMAIR venture to new state company TSUMCO, formalising the takeover of the mine.

title: Kazatomprom announces 1H2026 Financial Results
summary: Kazatomprom kept 2026 volume guidance but revised every financial metric on tenge strength and dearer sulphuric acid; first-half revenue rose 9% to about KZT718 billion.

title: Ur-Energy makes first shipment from Wyoming uranium project
summary: Ur-Energy trucked the first uranium from its Shirley Basin ISR satellite to the Lost Creek plant on 19 August, becoming a two-mine producer.

title: Urenco breaks ground for new enrichment capacity
summary: Urenco USA broke ground on a new plant at Eunice, New Mexico, that will add 2.1 million SWU, nearly 50% more US enrichment capacity.

title: Canadian miner NexGen Energy holds talks with BHP as it seeks $1 billion for uranium project
summary: Reuters reported NexGen has held talks with BHP as it seeks about USD1 billion of funding for its Rook I uranium project.

title: Construction starts at Saskatchewan uranium mine
summary: NexGen formally began the four-year build of Rook I in northern Saskatchewan, designed to produce about 30 Mlb of uranium a year.

title: Government approves extended operation of Almaraz plant
summary: Spain renewed the two-unit Almaraz plant's licence to June 2030, pushing back closures that had been scheduled for 2027 and 2028.

title: EU's uncertain stance on Russian nuclear fuel holds back investments, Urenco CEO says
summary: Urenco's chief executive said the lack of a clear EU position on Russian nuclear fuel is holding back investment in Western enrichment capacity.
